title: Option to show Master battery level on xDrip+ Sync Followers
symptom: As xDrip+ Sync Followers, we cannot see the battery level of the Master device (our son's phone). This causes missed readings when his phone battery dies, potentially leading to hypoglycemia if his blood sugar drops during that time.
evidence_quote: As xDrip+ Sync Followers, we'd like to be able to see the battery level of the Master device. That would be incredibly useful as we could tell our son in advance when to plug his phone.
